entries.note: The first scan in Lingdong's hands, at its Shenzhen warehouse.
Waiting for the flight it is booked on, after leaving the warehouse; the flight's day, month.day and in English, is read as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: 送往航司途中【On the way to the airline company】
entries.note: On its way to the airline after leaving the warehouse.
Waiting for the flight it is booked on; the flight's day of the month, in Chinese and in English, is read as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: 航班已起飞【The flight has taken off.】
航班已启运/Package in transit to destination country
航班已落地，拆板中/Package arrived at destination country
entries.note: The flight has landed and its pallets are being broken down.

entries.wording: 已完成国内报关手续【Domestic customs clearance procedures have been completed.】
entries.note: Cleared after the landing, before the delivery.

entries.wording: 货物已清关完成/Import customs clearance complete
entries.note: Released by the destination's customs, the day after the landing.

entries.wording: 拆板作业中，等待取货通知【Under destuffing, waiting for pickup instructions.】
entries.note: The flight's pallets are broken down after the landing while the cargo waits to be collected for clearance: not a collection by the recipient.

entries.wording: 货物在清关【Customs clearance in progress】
entries.note: In the destination's customs, after the landing.

entries.wording: 货物已完成清关【The goods have completed customs clearance】
entries.note: Released by the destination's customs, hours after its clearance began.

entries.wording: 货物已交服务商【The shipment has been transferred to the logistics partner.】
entries.note: The hand-over to the delivery partner after the import release.

entries.wording: First parcel scan along Poste Italiane’s logistic network
entries.note: Poste Italiane's first scan as the delivery partner, a day after the hand-over to it, relayed in capitals: the parcel is already on its way.

entries.wording: In transit along Poste Italiane’s logistic network
entries.note: Poste Italiane moving the parcel towards the office that delivers it.

entries.wording: 货物电子信息已经收到
entries.note: The platform writes this row itself for an order without scans, on its creation time.
